Select an item from the navigator
or create an inheritor
ConstructorStep1: 1. Find a base item — use search or browse groups in the navigator.
ConstructorStep2: 2. Click the item to open it — the editor loads all vanilla properties.
ConstructorStep3: 3. Scroll down to CREATE NEW ITEM, enter a name, and click Create.
ConstructorStep4: 4. Edit your item — change rarity, boosts, passives, description, icon.
ConstructorStep5: 5. Click SAVE (green button) to persist your changes.
ConstructorStep6: 6. Switch to the PATCHER tab, enable your item, and click PATCH.
ConstructorStep7: 7. Launch the game — your modded item will appear in loot!

TipGrantViaPassive: Instead of unlocking on equip, a hidden passive on this item unlocks the spell. Set its condition in the Passives section.
TipCreatureCopy: The copy keeps the creature's model and behaviour; only the stats below change.
TipEditOriginal:
Off (default): the card is a new spell of this item, compiled as <ItemId>_Spell_N that inherits the original; the original spell stays untouched everywhere else.
On: the card overrides the original spell itself (same name), so the change applies to every item, class and character that has this spell. The original's text stays translated in all languages until you edit the name or description.
TipAddCost: Add a resource the spell spends
TipSpellSlotsGroup: Spends a spell slot of this level, a regular or a Warlock pact slot: the same slot group every vanilla spell uses.
TipSpellWorkshop: Create spells here from existing ones: a new spell of this item, or a rebalance of the original. They are saved in this item's .art file. A new spell does nothing until you grant it: tick "Granted on equip", grant it through a passive, or add it to Granted spells or an UnlockSpell boost. An edited original needs no granting: it rebalances the spell in the game on its own.
TipGrantOnEquip: Adds the spell to this item's granted spells: whoever equips the item gets it.
TipContainer: A container: the player picks one of its variants when casting. Damage, rolls and effects live on the variants below; a cost or cooldown changed here is copied to the variants that had the same value.
TipIconsForSpell: A spell shows two pictures: the large one in its tooltip and the small one on the hotbar. Only icons that have both are offered.
TipIconsForStatus: A status shows only a small picture, so spell and item icons fit it too.
LblIconSource: Where the icon comes from: the game, AMP or another mod
WmSearchIconLibrary: Search by icon name or by the spell or status that uses it...

WarnIconFromMod: From the mod {0}: the icon shows only for players who have that mod.
TipPickStatusIcon: Choose from the icon library (status, spell or item icons)
TipStatusWorkshop: Statuses of this item: a copy of an existing status (your own version, or a rebalance of the original) or a status made from scratch. A status does nothing by itself until something applies it: tick "Applied while equipped", or apply it from a spell, a passive or a boost (ApplyStatus) — this item's own statuses come first in those lists. A copy replaces the original everywhere on this item: its spells, passives and boosts that apply the original apply the copy.
TipEditOriginalStatus:
Off (default): the card is a status of this item, compiled as <item ID>_Status_N on top of the original; the original status stays untouched everywhere else, and this item's spells, passives and boosts that apply the original apply the copy.
On: the card rewrites the original status itself (same name), so the change reaches every spell, item and character that applies it. Text you leave alone stays translated in every language.
WarnEditOriginalStatus: Changes apply everywhere this status is applied, not only by this item.
TipStatusCombatOnly: Removed when combat ends and does not hold outside it (the game's own pattern: Remove when combat ends + not Combat()). For a status applied on equip this means it is gone after the first fight — to limit an ability to battle, set the spell's Usable to In combat only instead.
TipApplyOnEquip: Adds the status to the item's StatusOnEquip: whoever wears the item has it until they take it off.
TipStackId: Statuses with the same StackId replace or stack with each other (by the stack type). A copy shares the original's, so it does not stack with the original.
TipStackType: What happens when the status is applied again while it is on
TipStatusAura: Statuses the bearer gives everyone within the radius (in metres)
TipStatusAppearance: Colour, effects, sounds and animations. Each is kept as in the original (↳), turned off, or set
TipStatusFormatColor: Colour of the status name in tooltips and the combat log
TipStatusStatusEffect: Visual effect shown on the character while the status lasts (.lsfx file)
TipStatusApplyEffect: Visual effect played once when the status is applied (.lsfx file)
TipStatusSoundStart: Sound played when the status is applied
TipStatusSoundLoop: Sound repeated while the status lasts
TipStatusSoundStop: Sound played when the status ends (stops the loop)
TipStatusSoundVocalStart: What the character says or groans when the status is applied
TipStatusSoundVocalLoop: Voice repeated while the status lasts (snoring, laughing…)
TipStatusSoundVocalEnd: What the character says when the status ends
TipStatusAnimationStart: Animation played when the status is applied
TipStatusAnimationLoop: Animation repeated while the status lasts
TipStatusAnimationEnd: Animation played when the status ends
TipStatusStillAnimationType: How the character stands while the status lasts (weakened, dazed, frightened…)
TipStatusStillAnimationPriority: Which pose wins when several statuses have one
TipTypingOn: Type values as text: formulas such as max(1,IntelligenceModifier), anything the drums don't list
TipTypedChipValue: Enter or leaving the box writes the value; Esc undoes. A red frame: brackets not closed or a comma outside them — not written.
LblTypedChipValues: Type values as text instead of drums
